items.example: I was gutted when we lost the final.
items.simple: Very, very sad because something good did not happen.

items.example: I'm so chuffed with my exam results!
items.simple: Very happy and proud about something good that happened to you.

items.example: She's over the moon about the new job.
items.simple: So happy that you feel like you are jumping up to the sky.

items.example: I'm fed up with this rain.
items.simple: You have had too much of something and you do not want any more.

items.example: I can't be bothered to cook tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu akşam yemek yapmaya canım istemiyor.
items.simple: You do not want to use your energy to do it.

items.example: I'm so stressed out about Monday.
items.simple: Your head feels full and tight because you worry about too many things.

items.example: I'm absolutely knackered after that run.
items.simple: So tired that your body wants to lie down right now.

items.example: I was a nervous wreck before my interview.
items.simple: A person who shakes and worries a lot before something big.

items.example: Sorry, I'm not in the mood to go out.
items.simple: You do not feel like doing it right now.

items.example: His loud chewing gets on my nerves.
items.simple: Someone does a small thing again and again, and it makes you cross.

items.example: She was heartbroken when her dog died.
items.simple: So very sad inside, like your heart is hurt.

items.example: I'm dying to tell you what happened!
items.exampleTr: Sana olanları anlatmak için can atıyorum!
items.simple: You want to do something so much that you can hardly wait.

items.example: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
items.simple: Suddenly you start to cry a lot.

items.example: This noise is driving me mad.
items.simple: Something is so annoying that you feel like you will shout.

items.example: I got really homesick in my first week abroad.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışındaki ilk haftamda evimi çok özledim.
items.simple: You are far from your home and you miss it very much.

items.example: I couldn't care less who wins.
items.simple: You say this when something does not matter to you at all.

items.example: I felt left out when everyone went to the party.
items.simple: Other people are playing together and you are not part of it.

items.example: She was devastated when he left.
items.simple: So sad that it feels like everything is broken.

items.example: I got really irritated by his comments.
items.simple: A bit cross because something small keeps bothering you.

items.example: I've been on edge all day.
items.simple: You feel tight inside, like something bad may happen soon.

items.example: I have mixed feelings about moving.
items.simple: You feel a little happy and a little sad at the same time.
